name: es20-shader-compilation
title: Shader and program objects
summary: Compile/link status and logs, multi-string sources, deferred deletion, validation, precision guarantees, shader binaries.
spec: GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.10 Linking of Vertex Outputs and Fragment Inputs
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID)

api.glCreateShader: valid and invalid shaders created; SHADER_TYPE verified
api.glShaderSource: 3 strings with lengths {-1,-1,N}: concatenation verified via glGetShaderSource
api.glCompileShader: COMPILE_STATUS TRUE for valid, FALSE for 2 invalid sources, no GL error
api.glGetShaderSource: returned source equals the concatenated strings
api.glDeleteShader: deferred while attached (glIsShader TRUE, DELETE_STATUS TRUE); deleted on detach; 0 ignored
api.glIsShader: TRUE while flagged and attached, FALSE after final detach
api.glGetAttachedShaders: returns exactly the two attached shader names
api.glLinkProgram: LINK_STATUS TRUE for valid programs, FALSE for varying mismatch and missing FS
api.glUseProgram: INVALID_OPERATION for an unlinked program; current program survives deletion
api.glDeleteProgram: deferred while current (glIsProgram TRUE, still renders), deleted when replaced
api.glValidateProgram: FALSE for sampler2D+samplerCube on one unit, TRUE after fixing the unit
api.glGetShaderPrecisionFormat: all 6 precision types x 2 stages meet GLSL ES 3.00 minimums
api.glUniform4f: per-program colors observed in the image
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit reassignment resolves the validation failure
api.glScissor: two halves drawn by different programs

visual_review.notes: Left half green (multi-string program A), right half blue (program B); no artifacts at the seam.
